message.content: { "title": "Tumba del Rey de Hierro", "language": "en", "recommended_level": "16", "hook": "The final chamber is a small, unfinished room filled with debris. Two broken shelves line the walls, their contents scattered among the shattered fragments of several clay pots. This room was used as a storage area for the tools used to maintain the tomb, as well as for the preparation of bodies for burial. A check of DC 15 Intelligence (Religion) reveals the purpose of the tools and the type of embalming process used on the remains. The embalming oils have long dried, and the herbs have withered to dust; however, scattered among the debris is a Potion of Healing, cast here by another adventurer while exploring the tomb.
